players.bio: Alex Simon McCarthy is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Leicester City. A product of Reading's Academy, McCarthy spent time out on loan in the Conference Premier before signing professional terms with the club in 2008.
Benjamin Harvey Nelson (born 18 March 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL League One club Leicester City.

Conor Chaplin is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or second striker for Leicester City. Born in Worthing, Chaplin progressed through Portsmouth's youth categories after joining the club at the age of six. He was offered a two-year scholarship contract on 3 July 2013.

David Joseph "Dai" Cornell is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Leicester City. He has also represented the Wales under-21 team. After progressing through Swansea City's Academy, Cornell was included in Swansea's senior squad for their 2008 pre-season tour of Spain.
Emil Riis Jakobsen (born 24 June 1998) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Leicester City.
Jakub Stolarczyk (born 19 December 2000) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Leicester City.
Jayden Kyle Joseph is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back and winger for EFL League One club Leicester City.

John David Lundstram is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City. Lundstram started his career in Everton's academy. He signed his first professional contract in June 2011 but never made a first-team appearance for Everton.
Liam Jamie Cullen (born 23 April 1999) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City and the Wales national team.
Louis Page (born 10 July 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City.
Memeh Caleb Okoli (born 13 July 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Leicester.

Russell Kenneth Alexander Martin (born 4 January 1986) is a professional football manager and former player who is currently the manager of EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in England, he represented Scotland at international level. A former defender, Martin began his playing career at Brighton & Hove Albion's youth academy.

Wes Burns is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a winger for Leicester City and the Wales national team. Born in Cardiff, Burns started his career at Bristol City, progressing through the club's academy to make his debut in January 2013.

William Anthony Patrick Smallbone (born 21 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in England, he plays for the Republic of Ireland national team.
